runs.notesForRun: First trial run, revised mid-day. Started with OnTheMarket only (Rightmove/Zoopla seemed to block automated fetching), then connected a real browser session and confirmed both Rightmove and Zoopla are in fact reachable that way. Switched to Zoopla's own 'travel time' search (public transport, 15 min, from Walthamstow Central) as the authoritative commute filter -- far more reliable than the original hand-estimated commute badges. That search returned 14 genuine candidates (2-3 bed, all confirmed within 15 min public transport of Walthamstow Central), spanning Walthamstow E17 and neighbouring Leyton E10. It found zero matches in Chingford/Highams Park (E4) or Clapton (E5), which contradicts several of the original hand-estimated 'pass'/'borderline' tags from the first pass -- those listings have been downgraded and dropped from today's current matches (kept in the archive). 3 solid Walthamstow E17 OnTheMarket listings from the first pass are carried over. One Zoopla listing (Knotts Green Road, Leyton) is for sale by auction -- guide price only, final price likely higher. Further revised: user confirmed Chingford/Highams Park (E4) and the Blackhorse Road area are acceptable target areas. Restored the 6 original Chingford listings to current matches with their original commute estimates. Re-searched Chingford directly (Zoopla's WMC-anchored travel-time search structurally can't return E4 results, so this needs a plain area search) and added 4 more fresh listings (Warren Road, Hall Gardens, York Road, The Ridgeway). Excluded a 5th candidate (Lakeview Court, Highams Park) despite being marketed as '2 bed' -- its own description says '1 bedroom apartment with separate study/room', which doesn't genuinely meet the 2-3 bed criterion. Also checked two Blackhorse Road-vicinity candidates (Cedars Avenue, Edinburgh Road) that surfaced under Zoopla's 'newest_listings' sort -- both turned out to be stale (originally listed Oct 2025 and June 2026 respectively, just bumped up by a recent price change), so neither qualifies under the 2-week freshness rule; genuinely nothing fresh near Blackhorse Road right now.

Manual catch-up run, not a full re-scan. Triggered by Charlie flagging that 'Lea Bridge Lofts, 363a Lea Bridge Road' (OnTheMarket 20182879) was missing from the tracker despite being a live listing. Root cause found: the only run so far (2026-08-24) searched OnTheMarket for Walthamstow (E17), Chingford (E4) and Clapton (E5), but never searched OnTheMarket for Leyton (E10) directly -- Leyton coverage that day came from Zoopla only. Nothing was deleted or lost; this listing (and a few others) were simply never in scope of that first search. Re-searched OnTheMarket for Leyton, Walthamstow and Chingford just now and added the 4 listings that are both genuinely new (added in the last ~7-14 days, i.e. since the 24th) and meet the 2-3 bed criterion: Lea Bridge Lofts (Leyton, the one Charlie flagged), 17B Oliver Road (Leyton, auction), Hornbeam Grove (Chingford), and Station Approach/Hoe Street (Walthamstow, over-budget penthouse kept for comparison -- it's literally by Walthamstow Central). Did not re-run Zoopla's travel-time search or re-check every area from scratch, so this is a targeted fix, not a full refresh -- a proper full run is still recommended when Charlie next wants an update.

Full scan, OnTheMarket + Zoopla. A browser was connected this run, so Zoopla was usable again for the first time since 24 Aug -- which matters, because Zoopla gives exact 'Listed on' dates whereas OnTheMarket only gives coarse '< 7 days / < 14 days' buckets that turn out to be unreliable for relisted properties. Areas searched: Walthamstow/E17, Chingford/E4 and Leyton/E10 (2-bed and 3-bed facets on OnTheMarket, plus Zoopla newest-first for each). CORRECTION, added after the run: the Blackhorse Road station and Highams Park facets were initially reported as covered but had NOT been searched in this pass -- they were run afterwards, on Charlie's prompting. Blackhorse Road station 2-bed and 3-bed and Highams Park 2-bed and 3-bed were then all checked and produced no additional listings meeting the criteria. Worth noting though: the Blackhorse Road 3-bed facet had never been run in any previous pass, and it surfaced several in-budget E17 three-beds that have never been in the tracker because they are all more than 14 days old and so fall outside the freshness rule -- Keith Road E17 at 475k (maisonette), Edinburgh Road E17 at 450k offers over (maisonette), Canal Walk E17 at 525k (flat) and Eastleigh Road/Upshire House E17 at 370k guide (apartment). Also seen there and excluded: 20226604 in E17 at 550k guide, added yesterday but over the budget guide, and Gloucester Road at 700k. 11 genuinely new listings added, all first listed 26-28 Aug, i.e. since the previous run: 5 in E17 (Stainforth Road, Frederic Street, Palmerston Road, Butterfields, Liden Close), 2 in E10 (Oliver Road/Johnston Court, Livingstone Court), 4 in E4 (Rushcroft Road, Willow Street, Harcourt House, 32 Antlers Hill). Best of them: Stainforth Road E17 at 8/10 and Frederic Street E17 at 8/10. 22 existing listings were re-confirmed live and had lastSeen moved to today; nothing existing was edited beyond that, and nothing was removed. Excluded on the usual quality bar: Homewise / 'Home for Life' lifetime-lease listings for over-60s (Gloucester Road E17, Willow Street E4 at 314k, Centenary House), which are not open-market sales; shared-ownership listings (Coronation Square, Beck Square, Old Brewery Way); retirement properties (Chelwood Close, Riverside Court); over-budget listings (Nelson Road 725k, Chingford Mount Road 585k, Cobham Road 750k, Roma Road 775k, Chaucer Road 725k, Ashville Road 650k, Richmond Road 725k); properties outside the confirmed areas (Ashville Road and Richmond Road E11, Maryland E15, the N17 Hale Village blocks); and price-reduction-only or relisted-but-stale entries, which are not newly posted -- notably Hitcham Road at 450k (OnTheMarket said 'Added < 7 days' but Zoopla shows it as 'Back to market', originally listed 11 Mar 2026) and Manston Court (originally listed 2 Feb 2026). Valley Side E4 is the same story: OnTheMarket shows '< 7 days' but Zoopla has it listed 16 Mar 2026. TWO THINGS TO BE AWARE OF. (1) This run built on the archive.json currently on the Desktop, which was rewritten by a separate manual catch-up run on 28 Aug. That catch-up was working from the 24 Aug archive and did not have the output of the 26 Aug automated run, so 12 in-scope listings that the 26 Aug run had added are no longer in the file (Manor Road, Hitcham Road, Upper Walthamstow Road, St Stephens Close and Hawker Place in E17; Hainault Road, Sophia Road, Thornhill Road, Newport Road, Huxley Road and Waterloo Road in E10; Burnham Road in E4). All twelve were re-confirmed as still live on the portals today. They were NOT re-added here, because this run was explicitly scoped to new listings only -- they can be restored on request. (2) STALE_DAYS is 4 and the latest run date is now 29 Aug, so any listing still carrying lastSeen 2026-08-24 has aged out of current matches into the archive. That mostly affects above-budget entries, but two in-budget ones go with them: Forest Road E17 (which did not appear in today's Zoopla results and may be under offer) and Linnett Close E4 (not found on OnTheMarket today).

Weekly scan, OnTheMarket + Zoopla, browser connected. Areas searched: Walthamstow/E17, Chingford/E4 and Leyton/E10 -- 2-bed and 3-bed facets on OnTheMarket for each, plus Zoopla newest-first (pages 1 and 2) for each. IMPORTANT METHOD NOTE: OnTheMarket's bed-count facet pages turned out to be near-useless for spotting new stock this run -- they returned essentially the same first page as on 29 Aug, including the same 'Reduced yesterday' tag on Cleveland Park Road, because those pages sort by relevance rather than date and the sort parameter is disallowed by OnTheMarket's robots.txt. Zoopla's newest-first sort found roughly 36 listings added in the same window that OnTheMarket's page 1 never surfaced. Treat Zoopla as the source of truth for freshness from here on; OnTheMarket is still useful for confirming a listing is still live (presence), just not for discovering new ones. 11 new listings added and fully scored, all first listed 30 Aug - 4 Sep: 5 in E17 (Kimberley Road, Vallentin Road, Haroldstone Road, Chingford Road/Lloyd Park, Wren House), 3 in E10 (Ruckholt Road, Warren Road, Murchison Road), 3 in E4 (Shingly Place, Cherrydown Close, Stapleford Close). Standouts: Ruckholt Road E10 8/10 (1,121 sq ft three-bed at 379/sq ft, ~240-year lease, underground parking), Shingly Place E4 8/10 (cheapest 3-bed/2-bath in the tracker at 400k), Kimberley Road E17 8/10 (three-bed house with garden under budget) and Vallentin Road E17 8/10 (cheapest move-in-ready two-bed, 177-year lease, fully disclosed terms). 31 existing listings were re-confirmed live and had lastSeen moved to today; nothing existing was edited beyond that and nothing was removed. Excluded on the usual quality bar: shared-ownership (four Priory Court units, Coronation Square, Beck Square); Homewise / 'Home for Life' over-60s lifetime leases (Gloucester Road, Centenary House, Willow Street at 314k); retirement properties; over-budget stock; anything outside the confirmed areas (Melford Road and Millais Road E11, Ashville Road E11, Maryland E15, and St. Marys Road NW10 which Zoopla surfaced as a promoted listing inside the Leyton search -- worth watching for, since promoted results are not area-filtered); and relisted-but-stale entries (Hitcham Road at 450k, first listed 11 Mar; Manston Court, 2 Feb; Cheney Row, 17 Jul). NOT YET ASSESSED: roughly 20 further listings did clear the coarse filters (2-3 bed, under ~525k, posted in the window) but were not individually opened and scored this run, because the week produced far more candidates than a single pass could properly evaluate. They are mostly 475k-525k two-beds of 620-690 sq ft in E17 -- the crowded middle of the market -- plus three E10 auction lots. They are listed in the chat summary for this run and can be assessed on request. Two listings dropped out of current matches this run, having not been found on either portal: York Road E4 and Lea Bridge Road E10. Forest Road E17 was also absent, confirming the suspicion recorded on 29 Aug that it had gone under offer. CORRECTION (same day, after Charlie spotted it): the original pass MISSED the tenure and running-cost data on several of these listings. Two extraction faults were responsible. First, the description text was truncated at 1,500 characters, which cut off the 'Tenure Information' block that some agents put at the END of the description -- that is how Ruckholt Road's approx. £500 per month service charge, £450 ground rent and band C council tax were all missed. Second, and separately, Zoopla renders a STRUCTURED FACTS PANEL further down every listing page (service charge / council tax band / ground rent / ground rent review period) that the extractor never looked at at all; that panel is where Shingly Place's £2,047 service charge and £483 ground rent reviewed every five years were hiding. Both sources must be read on every future run. Consequences: Ruckholt Road E10 is DOWNGRADED from 8/10 to 6/10 -- at £6,450 a year in service charge plus ground rent it carries roughly three times the fixed cost of anything else here, equivalent to about £90,000 of extra mortgage, so it behaves like a £515k property rather than a £425k one and the 'best value in the tracker' claim made when it was flagged was wrong. Shingly Place E4 is downgraded from 8/10 to 7/10 on the discovery of a five-yearly ground rent review, which is a lender-relevant risk. Warren Road E10 keeps 7/10 with its ground rent now confirmed at a negligible £50 a year. Wren House, Haroldstone Road and Chingford Road were re-checked and their charges really are published as 'ask agent', so 'not stated' was accurate for those three. Kimberley Road shows no tenure fields at all, consistent with freehold but still unconfirmed. The 8/10 list for this run is therefore Kimberley Road E17 and Vallentin Road E17 only.
